sideB.summary: If they are still around, destroy Complete the Plan and The Plan. One new mandatory objective is enclosed, and December needs only that 1 objective. The calendar shows December with 1 star and 0.
sideB.text:
DESTROY THE FOLLOWING CARDS IF YOU HAVE NOT DONE SO ALREADY:
• COMPLETE THE PLAN
• THE PLAN

A new mandatory objective is enclosed.
We only need to complete this 1 objective in December.

Calendar: DECEMBER 1 star, 0.

mechanics.whenRead: During the first December setup draw, after the journal 12-02. The enclosed mandatory objective is the next card, 12-04.
destroys: COMPLETE THE PLAN objective, if it has not already been destroyed
THE PLAN card (11-05), if it has not already been destroyed
rules: Destroy Complete the Plan and The Plan if those cards are still in play.
December requires 1 objective, the mandatory objective enclosed with this card.
mechanics.notes: A sliver of the previous month's column is visible at the left edge of the inset and is not readable. December's column is outlined. Same calendar as 11-03: the star is the objective count and 0 is that month's projected stockpile. This card does not print a 'place Supply cubes' sentence.
